title: CDrus Workflow
description: Defines a workflow in the CDrus language. A workflow orchestrates CDEvents and references CDrus Expressions by identity. Expressions are addressed via the (group, author, expression) identity tuple defined in the Expression schema.

id.description: Unique identifier for this workflow definition.

group.description: Group component of the workflow's identity. Provides the default resolution context for abbreviated expression references in this workflow's produces list. An expression reference of the form 'build' resolves against this group and author before any fully qualified lookup is attempted.

author.description: Author component of the workflow's identity. Provides the default resolution context for abbreviated expression references in this workflow's produces list. An expression reference of the form 'build' resolves against this group and author before any fully qualified lookup is attempted.

version.description: Schema version this workflow YAML targets.

defaults.description: Default values applied to every event node in this workflow.

produces.description: Ordered list of CDEvents and/or CDrus Expression references.

produce_item.description: A workflow produce item is either a CDEvent or a reference to a CDrus Expression by identity.

event_item.description: An inline event in a workflow's produces list.

expression_item.description: A reference to a CDrus Expression by identity. Expressions are identified by the (group, author, expression) tuple defined in the Expression schema. Path-style references resolve abbreviated forms against the workflow's current processing context.

expression.description: Reference to a CDrus Expression by identity, in path form. Three reference forms are supported: 'build' (resolved against the workflow's own group and author); 'mchen/build' (explicit author within the workflow's group); 'payment-engineering/mchen/build' (fully qualified identity).
